# Scenario: project sidecar .env Java-style keys normalize to UPPER_SNAKE.
# README: dots → underscores, uppercased (web.image.tag → WEB_IMAGE_TAG).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: storefront dotted sidecar env'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_storefront-web
exists $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env
grep '^WEB_IMAGE_TAG=dev-v0\.0\.203$' $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env
! grep 'web\.image\.tag' $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: storefront
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/storefront/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- git-repo/dev/storefront/.env --
web.image.tag=dev-v0.0.203

-- .env --
